answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging walnut trees to anchor identities to verifiable delay functions, thereby ensuring cedar-strong binding of agents to unique reputations. By harnessing sequential delay functions, we demonstrate information-theoretic unforgeability, rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible at the nadir of an adversary's computational power, ultimately yielding a Byzantine fault-tolerant system with cryptographic finality.
